editorial.blurb: El Nuevo Mexicano serves authentic Mexican fare with genuine hospitality, backed by a 9-star reputation and 710 devoted reviews.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the michelada—reviewers rave it's one of the best they've had and worth a solo visit. Pair it with the enchiladas with mole or carnitas with mango plantain salsa, both called out as standouts.
